notes.label: vanilla-baseline
notes.what_this_build_is: Base game with no mod under test; only the harness instrumentation mod (on_actions and debug_log lines, no economic content).
notes.why_running: Reference for run time and British market state over a full campaign.
caveats: Arms are interleaved, so any drift over the batch hits both equally.

notes.label: tiering-only-stub
notes.what_this_build_is: All 67 tier buildings, but every tier's recipe, build cost and ai_value are the base game's (tools/testbed/make_vanilla_stub.ps1).
notes.differs_from_baseline: Only the structure: modernising requires CONSTRUCTING the next tier instead of flipping a production method.
notes.why_running: Isolate the effect of the tier split itself from our re-sloped recipes.
caveats: Built with -NoLint: off the break-even ladder by construction.
shipyard_steam has no pre-split vanilla building, so its cost/ai_value stay as configured.
